name: park-water
source: USGS National Hydrography Dataset (NHD) High Resolution, HU8 staged shapefiles NHD_H_18040006_HU8_Shape.zip, NHD_H_18040008_HU8_Shape.zip, NHD_H_18040009_HU8_Shape.zip, NHD_H_18090101_HU8_Shape.zip
processing: Named flowlines and unnamed perennial streams (FCode 46006); lakes/ponds (FType 390) and reservoirs (436) of at least 0.002 km²; intersecting parkBounds; features already in waterways.geojson and artificial paths through kept lakes left out; Douglas–Peucker 3 m; rounded to 5 decimals; NAD83 used as WGS84
